scope: Synthetic numeric feature/objective equivalence only; no image, oracle, optimizer step, training or quality claim
exactPrinciple: All trainable ASCII rows and every CTC target class are retained. Remaining unmodified rows enter one exact logsumexp OTHER scalar. OTHER is never a target. CTC paths and denominator are unchanged. Every omitted teacher/student logit is identical, so their teacher-KL probability ratios share the same normalization shift and aggregate exactly. Inference still uses full18710 rows/dictionary.
